cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take you through the crash in order. You asked whether the roads were wet: they were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked whether you were driving too fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll get there. Do you want me to write it down? The rain started before I left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Write your speed. That's what the insurer needs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put the time beside it too. On your first question: heavy rain from six until eight.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs report order, A3 offers writing to keep B involved, A5 offers time detail while returning to safe weather.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 speeding question is dodged by earlier rain; B4 written-speed request gets beside-it wording without supplying what it would sit beside.

relationship.evidence: B4 insurer need gives B a practical reason to insist on a number.

heightening.evidence: A5 adapts to writing but adds an unnecessary time-beside-it promise before the actual weather answer.

specificity.evidence: A1 crash, B2 speed and B4 insurer make the reporting stakes clear.
